dataset: code_classification_dataset (4,982 problems), statements after codeforces_tags preprocessing

detector_under_audit.vectors: TF-IDF on prob_desc_description, word 1-2 grams, sublinear tf
detector_under_audit.default_after_audit: two stages: TF-IDF cosine >= 0.4 on prob_desc_description, then these verdicts

candidate_signals.same_contest_and_word: same release timestamp and word cosine >= 0.25
candidate_signals.both_version: same release timestamp and both statements mention an easy/hard version

B: word<0.4, strong signal.selection: all (same contest, both mention a version, or char >= 0.6)

C: word<0.4, weak signal only (sample).selection: random sample, random_state=0 (only identical sample input or similar code)

text_shown_to_judges.hidden: sample ids, similarity scores, signals and tiers

judging.first_pass: 10 LLM agents (Claude), ~49 pairs each, every pair labelled once
judging.second_pass_round_1: 1 independent LLM agent, blind to the first label, on the pairs selected by second_pass_round_1_rule
judging.second_pass_round_1_rule: judged duplicate with word < 0.8, or low confidence, or judged not duplicate with word >= 0.8
judging.second_pass_round_2: 9 independent LLM agents, blind to the first label, ~51 pairs each, on every pair not re-judged in round 1, so that every pair has two judges
judging.final_rule: duplicate when at least one judge says same_problem or versions: a wrong link only keeps two problems on the same side of a split, while a wrong cut leaks

judges.extended_thinking: on: the recorded transcripts contain thinking blocks
judges.prompts: src/codeforces_tags/near_duplicates/audit/templates/*.j2 (Jinja2); rendering them reproduces the 20 prompts of the recorded judges exactly (30 transcripts: 10 first-pass launches were interrupted after a few seconds and relaunched with the same prompts; only the relaunched answers are used)
judges.harness_of_the_recorded_run: Claude Code 2.1.284 (desktop) workflow subagents. Each judge received the task prompt indented under a harness header, the subagent system prompt and the repository's CLAUDE.md (duplicate counts, no pair labels). The first-pass and round-1 judges were also relayed the user question that triggered the run (how the threshold was set, and how to rule out missed pairs); the round-2 judges were not. Tools used: Read, Bash
judges.reproduction: python -m codeforces_tags.near_duplicates.audit judge <pass> <folder> runs claude-agent-sdk with the same model, effort, prompt and schema. Differences from the recorded run: the SDK's own minimal system prompt, the CLI bundled with the SDK (2.1.286 with claude-agent-sdk 0.2.163), no CLAUDE.md and no relayed question, and a single tool, Read, confined to the texts/ folder that holds only the pair texts (every other call is refused)
